persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Swap the park behind me for a sunny beach with sand and blue sea. Keep my face, hair, sweater and head-and-shoulders framing the same. Still square, please.
bank.Beach setting: A photorealistic sunny beach with visible sand and blue sea; the location is your call.
bank.What to preserve: My face, curly hair, sweater, pose and head-and-shoulders framing.
bank.Size and added text: One square image at the standard free size. No added text.

messages.text: Could you edit this pic of me so the park behind me is replaced with a sunny beach? I just feel like a beach background would make this photo feel a little more cheerful. I want sand and blue sea in the background, and it should still be square, please. Keep my face, hair and sweater exactly the same as they are in this pic. Please keep the same head-and-shoulders framing too.
